user.title: Dynamic Heating Control
user.description: Choose the thermostat, room temperature sensor and schedule helper. Control stays disabled after setup.

data_description.person_entities: Comfort heating is allowed when at least one selected person or device tracker is home. Device trackers are recommended for simple home/not-home states.
data_description.enter_home_duration: The home state must remain stable for this long before comfort heating is allowed.
data_description.leaving_home_duration: After the last selected person leaves, wait this long before switching to setback temperature.
data_description.guest_entity: An active guest toggle counts as someone being home.
data_description.proximity_entity: Choose the Home Assistant Proximity distance sensor, for example the distance-to-zone or nearest-distance sensor. Older combined proximity entities remain supported.
data_description.proximity_duration: The direction must continuously point towards home within the configured range for this long before comfort heating is allowed. Changing distance readings do not restart the timer; a direction change or unavailable reading does.
data_description.proximity_distance: Maximum approach distance in meters. Distance values in m, km, miles, feet or yards are normalized to meters before comparison.
data_description.presence_entity: Comfort heating is allowed only while this sensor reports presence and the configured household presence source also allows heating.
data_description.presence_schedule_entity: The presence sensor is used only while this schedule is on. When off, sensor motion is ignored.
data_description.presence_on_duration: Presence must remain on for this long before it is accepted.
data_description.presence_off_duration: After the sensor turns off, keep presence accepted for this long before switching to setback.
data_description.proximity_direction_entity: Choose the matching direction-of-travel sensor. The states towards, arrived, away_from and stationary are understood. For new Proximity entities, select the distance and direction sensors separately.
data_description.proximity_max_age: If the distance sensor has not updated within this duration, its position is considered stale. No new heating decision is made from stale proximity data; a person/guest tracker that already confirms home still takes precedence.

error.eco_must_be_below_comfort: The setback temperature must be lower than the comfort temperature.

abort.already_configured: A dynamic heating controller is already configured for this thermostat.

init.title: Edit room
init.description: After creating a room, you can change its thermostat, sensors, schedule, and temperatures. Leave optional sensors empty to disable them.
